_comment: The directory. `house: in` = we run it. `house: out` = someone else runs it and we send people. Every out-of-house entry starts at status `proposed` until a human at New Life confirms it. Never move an entry to `verified` from a web page alone.

standard.eyebrow: How a ministry gets on this list
standard.title: We put our name next to these.
standard.body: This list is not a phone book. Every ministry on it has to clear the same four tests before we will put our name next to it.

tests.name: Close enough to actually go
tests.body: A ministry two hours away is a fact, not an option. We look for the best thing you can reach on a weeknight, and we tell you where it meets before we tell you anything else.
tests.short: The best thing you can reach on a weeknight, and we tell you where it meets first.

tests.name: A real person on the other end
tests.body: We are not looking for a referral form. We are looking for someone we can call, who knows we are sending you, and who will still be there in six months.
tests.short: Someone we can call who knows we are sending you.

tests.name: Better at this than we would be
tests.body: If a ministry has been doing one thing for 20 years, our version of it would be worse. That is the whole point. We would rather send you to excellence than keep you inside our building.
tests.short: A ministry that has done this for years does it better than our version would.

tests.name: A calendar they actually keep
tests.body: If a ministry publishes real dates and keeps them current, we can pull their calendar straight onto this site and you will always see what is next. Ministries that keep a live calendar are the ones we can carry best.
tests.short: Dates they keep current, so we can carry their calendar here.

entries.why: Strong on the twenties-and-thirties years, which is exactly where we have the least to offer right now.
entries.rhythm: Sundays, plus what's on their calendar

handoff.how: Check their calendar for the next date, then turn up. Ask us and we will make an introduction first.

entries.name: All Nations Church
entries.summary: A Pentecostal congregation on the southwest side with a midweek gathering and a public calendar feed.
entries.why: Midweek is the hardest thing to find in this city and one of the few things a working family can actually build a week around.

entries.summary: A Pentecostal church under three miles away that runs nights of worship and posts them as they come.
entries.why: Worship nights are the thing our people would most recognise as home, and there are only eight churches in the area publishing them at all.
